build.buildCommand: composer install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader && npm ci && npm run build

deploy.startCommand: php artisan migrate --force && php artisan storage:link && php artisan config:cache && php artisan route:cache && php artisan view:cache && (php-fpm -y /assets/php-fpm.conf &) && node /assets/scripts/prestart.mjs /assets/nginx.template.conf /nginx.conf && nginx -c /nginx.conf
